# Harmonic Security (Harmonic Security, Inc.)

Harmonic Security is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Harmonic Security employs 56 people and has an annual revenue of $1M, founded in 2023. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom. Has $24.5M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.

## About

AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.

## About Harmonic Security

Harmonic Security focuses on secure artificial intelligence (AI) adoption within enterprises, specializing in data protection and security for the AI era. The company offers solutions that protect sensitive data, increase visibility into unauthorized AI applications, and ensure compliance while supporting innovation. Harmonic Security serves sectors integrating generative AI tools and maintaining data security measures. It was founded in 2023 and is based in San Francisco, California.
